title: Enrichment analysis of systemic lupus erythematosus susceptible loci identified by genome-wide association studies.
one_liner_zh: 该文为SLE易感位点的基因本体与通路富集分析，纯统计与功能注释，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无结合建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a systemic autoimmune disease. Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified several loci associated with susceptibility to the disease. For the current analysis, enrichment analysis was performed using predicted SLE loci. SLE-associated loci were retrieved from the GWAS database. Gene ontology functional annotation and Reactome pathway analysis were performed using the Enrichr online server. A total of 293 loci encoding susceptible SLE proteins were identified. The analysis revealed that genes associated with SLE were primarily involved in cytokine signaling in the immune system, as demonstrated by the Reactome pathway analysis. In addition, gene ontology analysis suggested that SLE-associated genes were primarily involved in the immune system and its functions. Statistical analysis revealed that 9 segments of the human chromosome had a significantly higher number of SLE-associated genes. Specifically, the 6p21.31-p22.2 and 19p13.2-p13.3 contained 34 and 12 SLE-associated genes, respectively. This study showed that rheumatoid arthritis and multiple sclerosis share 33 and 42 genes, respectively, with SLE, and among the shared genes, four genes CD40, STAT4, TYK2, and IL2RA are involved in the cytokine signaling pathway in the immune system. It might suggest that positive regulation of cytokine production pathway is a common pathway among autoimmune diseases.
abstract_zh: 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种系统性自身免疫性疾病。全基因组关联研究（GWAS）已识别出多个与该疾病易感性相关的位点。在当前分析中，使用预测的SLE位点进行了富集分析。从GWAS数据库中检索了SLE相关位点。使用Enrichr在线服务器进行了基因本体功能注释和Reactome通路分析。共识别出293个编码SLE易感蛋白的位点。分析显示，与SLE相关的基因主要参与免疫系统中的细胞因子信号传导，这一点由Reactome通路分析所证实。此外，基因本体分析表明，SLE相关基因主要涉及免疫系统及其功能。统计分析显示，人类染色体的9个区段中SLE相关基因数量显著较高。具体而言，6p21.31-p22.2和19p13.2-p13.3分别包含34个和12个SLE相关基因。本研究表明，类风湿关节炎和多发性硬化症分别与SLE共享33个和42个基因，在共享基因中，CD40、STAT4、TYK2和IL2RA这四个基因参与免疫系统中的细胞因子信号传导通路。这可能提示，细胞因子产生通路的正调控是自身免疫性疾病中的共同通路。
